_readme: Webpage URL-extraction sanity cases (GitHub Pages). Built by build_cases.py. Organised as single/ (one URL per type), combined/ (edge types mixed), bulk/ (many URLs per type), base-relative/ (a <base href> + many relative anchors per page), relative/ (resolved vs serving URL), negative/ (must-not-extract), info/ (open behaviour). present = absolute URLs that must appear in the antispam-log urlList; presentTemplate uses {BASE} (deploy base incl. /repo) / {ORIGIN} (scheme+host); absent = must not appear; info=true -> log only.
